updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.5.5 
- Fix F-14 Mini Wheel unchecked nreaking IC. 
- Update F-14 Jester scripts to release version. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 command remapping Radar, Air to ground,  Air to air, Weapons selection and fuzing. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 new crew contract commands. 
- F-14 Jester 1.5 new Air to Ground Commands, JDAM and GGW options. 
- Fix F-14 Jester 1.5 Radar active/standby, elevation and azimuth commands 
- Adds check of module prior to sending AIRIO command 
- Performance improvements and additional logging for process server data 
- F-14 AIRIO new radar elevation commands (replace old ones to allow more options)
